adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is initialized to `[eventType.destinationCalendar]` when an event-type destination calendar exists (instead of including the organizer’s `organizerUser.destinationCalendar`). Then for COLLECTIVE team events it appends `teamDestinationCalendars` gathered from `users.slice(1)` (explicitly excluding the organizer). This means the organizer’s personal destination calendar is not included when `eventType.destinationCalendar` is set, so `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents()` will not create an event for the organizer’s own calendar in that case. Also, if the event-type destination calendar matches a team member’s personal `user.destinationCalendar`, it can be present twice (first element + appended), leading to duplicate create attempts for that same calendar.
